source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Earth's climate system (PDF 178).

blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq zameen ka climate system kisi ilaqe mein temperature, barish, hawa aur doosre mausami halaat ka lambe arse ka pattern hai. Yeh zameen ke tamam jandaron aur qudrati nizamon par asar karta hai. Climate qudrati cheezon (jaise Sooraj aur samandari currents) aur insani kaamon (jaise fossil fuels jalana aur jangal kaatna) se banta hai. Zameen ka climate samajh kar hum climate change (mausam ki lambi tabdeeli) ke asraat ke liye tayyari aur un mein kami kar sakte hain. Zameen ka climate system paanch hisson (components) se bana hai: atmosphere (hawa), hydrosphere (pani), cryosphere (barf aur permafrost, yani hamesha jami rehne wali zameen), lithosphere (zameen ki oopar wali chattani tah) aur biosphere (jandaar). Yeh hisse mil kar kaam karte aur aik doosre par asar dalte hain; aik hisse mein tabdeeli doosron mein bhi tabdeeli la sakti hai. Climate system ke hisse aur un ka aapas ka amal Fig. 21.10 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal: garmi se barf (cryosphere) pighle to neeche ki gehri zameen aur samandar khul jate hain jo zyada dhoop jazb karte hain; is se hawa (atmosphere) aur garam hoti hai. Yun aik hisse ki tabdeeli doosre ko badalti hai.

blocks.alt: THE CLIMATE SYSTEM: Space, Atmosphere aur Geosphere ki tahon wala khaaka. Sooraj ki Solar Radiation neeche, Terrestrial Radiation (Long-wave) oopar, greenhouse gases ke note. Stratosphere, troposphere, badal, barf-baari, barish, hawayein, gases wala aatish-fishan (volcano), biomass, transpiration, mitti se evaporation, runoff, percolation, aquifer, insani sargarmiyan, hararat aur gas ka tabadla, sea ice, glaciers, satah aur gehri dhaarein; Lithosphere, Hydrosphere, Cryosphere; legend.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.10: zameen ke mausami nizam ke hisse aur un ka baahami amal (kitab ki Figure 21.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Paanchon hisse yahan dikhte hain: atmosphere (hawa, badal), hydrosphere (samandar, currents), cryosphere (sea ice, glaciers), lithosphere (zameen, chattanein) aur biosphere (darakht, biomass). Teer batate hain ke energy, pani aur gases aik hisse se doosre mein kaise jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Figure 21.10 mein 'Volcanie' aur 'Solar Tradiation' chhapa hai. Sahi alfaaz 'Volcanic' aur 'Solar Radiation' hain, jo hum ne figure mein likhe hain.

blocks.prompt: Agar zameen achanak ghoomna band kar de to hawaon aur samandari currents par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Coriolis effect (ghoomne se hawa ka murna) khatam ho jata, is liye hawa garam (equator) aur thande (poles) ilaqon ke darmiyan zyada seedhi chalti; ghoomne par munhasir mure hue hawa ke belts (trade winds, westerlies) aur gol samandari gyres zyada tar khatam ho jate. (Achanak rukne se fiza aur samandar apni purani raftar se chalte rehte, is liye shuru mein tabahkun hawayein aur lehrein bhi aatin.)

items: Climate: lambe arse ka mausami pattern; qudrati aur insani asraat.
Paanch hisse: atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere, lithosphere, biosphere; sab aik doosre par asar dalte hain.
